mechanism: Isoniazid may inhibit hepatic metabolism and potentially increase atenolol levels, while isoniazid itself can cause peripheral neuropathy and CNS effects that may be compounded by beta-blocker use.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate regularly; consider alternative antituberculosis agents if beta-blocker efficacy is compromised or adverse effects emerge; ensure adequate vitamin B6 supplementation during isoniazid therapy.
